metadata.title: Spherical $t$-Designs on $\mathbb S^2$ with $54t^2$ Points
metadata.abstract: We prove that, for every integer $t\geq 1$, the unit two-sphere admits a spherical $t$-design consisting of exactly $54t^2$ points. More generally, such a design exists with exactly $6q^2$ points for every integer $q\geq 3t$. The proof builds on the topological degree method of Bondarenko, Radchenko and Viazovska, using an explicit equal-area partition of the sphere based on the map of Roşca and Plonka. By choosing the cell centers to minimize the average squared geodesic distance and deriving sharper sampling estimates, we obtain the stated quadratic bound on the size of spherical $t$-designs on $\Sph$.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.workSummary: 在 S2 上给出具有精确显式规模的球面 t-design 存在构造，得到 54t² 这一上界。
analysis.breakthrough: 把最优量级 O(t²) 具体化为可核查的点数常数和更一般 6q² 形式。
analysis.limitations: 这是存在上界而非证明最少点数为 54t²；离散结构的显式程度需与证明中的存在步骤区分。仅依据官方英文摘要及作者评论，尚未核查正文与完整证明；技术说明仅限摘要明确的信息，关键结论需回查原文。AI 披露另见独立核查记录；未检索到声明不代表没有使用 AI。
